_comment: Every map's extracts (DESIGN.md §5). Each map has 1 to 3, and at least one always-open extract every side can use, so a raid can always be left. A map scene places each one as an ExtractZone whose extract_id is the entry's id; where it is and its radius are in the scene, the rules here. Entry: id, name, type and its fields. type 'always': open every raid. 'random': open this raid with `chance` (0-1), rolled at raid start; you don't know until you see it. 'conditional': open every raid, but only works once its conditions are met: `item` (an item id you must carry, e.g. a key; `consumes` true uses one up when you extract), `price` (roubles, paid at the extract with F), `power` (true: the map's power switch must be on), `flare` (true: fire a signal flare inside it, F), `no_gear` (equipment slots that must be empty: backpack, armor (body armor), helmet, rig, primary...), `quest` (a quest id: the extract only exists for you once that quest is completed; it counts toward the map's 1-3). Any type can have `sides` (Both, PMC or Scav; default Both). AI Scavs and PMCs use the same extracts, except paid, flare and quest ones.
